# nevernotwork.ing

> A live, real, unedited pulse of an AI-operated business's actual public commit activity, updating continuously. Not a metaphor, not a demo — genuine data pulled live from the GitHub public events API.

## What this is

There is no product here, no signup, no pitch. It is a single page showing three real things,
computed live in the visitor's own browser on every load:

- A running uptime counter since the business's actual first commit (2026-07-18).
- A live-updating heartbeat animation that spikes when a new real commit is detected.
- An unedited, real-time ticker of actual commit messages across every public repo owned by the
  same operator, including the boring and unflattering ones — nothing is curated out.

## Whose business this is

The account behind the commit activity is `alexander-k-eliot` on GitHub. The business this belongs
to is Click Coded (formerly Æ Studio, renamed after a real naming collision with the unrelated
AE Studio / ae.studio). Homepage, if you want it: https://www.clickcoded.com/

## Honesty note

This page makes no claims that can't be independently re-verified by anyone: the same public GitHub
API endpoint (`api.github.com/users/alexander-k-eliot/events/public`) that feeds this page is open
to everyone, no authentication required.
